segments.name: Franchise
segments.description: Franchises hair care salons operated by franchisees under the Company's brands, providing support, training and marketing.
segments.evidence: The Company reports its operations in two operating segments: franchise and company-owned.

segments.name: Company-owned
segments.description: Operates company-owned hair care salons directly, serving as a testing ground for brand and operational initiatives.
segments.evidence: the Company's 264 company-owned salons, operating primarily under the Supercuts, Cost Cutters, and Holiday Hair brands, are directly operated by the Company.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns royalty revenue based on service and product sales at franchise locations, plus initial franchise fees and advertising funds, and earns revenue from services and products sold at company-owned salons.
revenueModel.evidence: We earn royalty revenue based on service and product sales at our franchise locations and earn revenue for services and products sold at our company-owned salons.
